blocks.narrator: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr ibn As (RA)
blocks.arabic_text: كُتِبَ مِنَ الْقَانِتِينَ، وَمَنْ قَرَأَ بِأَلْفِ آيَةٍ كُتِبَ مِنَ الْمُقَنْطِرِينَ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever recites ten ayahs in the Tahajjud Salah will not be written that night among the heedless (who forget Allah); whoever recites a hundred ayahs will be written among the devout worshippers; and whoever recites a thousand ayahs will be written among those who receive reward equal to a heap (qintar).” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr ibn As (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: الْقِنْطَارُ اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَلْفَ أُوقِيَّةٍ كُلُّ أُوقِيَّةٍ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَاْلاَرْضِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “A (qintar) consists of twelve thousand uqiyahs, and each uqiyah is better than everything that is between the heavens and the earth.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: رَحِمَ اللهُ رَجُلاً قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَصَلَّي ثُمَّ أَيْقَظَ امْرَأَتَهُ فَصَلَّتْ فَإِنْ أَبَتْ نَضَحَ فِي وَجْهِهَا الْمَاءَ، وَرَحِمَ اللهُ امْرَأَةً قَامَتْ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَصَلَّتْ ثُمَّ أَيْقَظَتْ زَوْجَهَا فَصَلَّي فَإِنْ أَبَي نَضَحَتْ فِي وَجْهِهِ الْمَاءَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه النسائي باب الترغيب في قيام الليل رقم:١٦١١
blocks.tamil_translation: “A man gets up at night, prays Tahajjud and wakes his wife as well, and she too gets up and prays; (if, overcome by sleep,) she does not get up, he lightly sprinkles water on her face and wakes her — may Allah have mercy on such a man! Likewise, a woman got up at night, prayed Tahajjud and woke her husband, and he too got up and prayed;
